translation: In the condition of autumn dryness, the qi aspect is first affected, so treating the lung is urgent. If it drags on for several tens of days, the disease must enter the blood aspect, and it can no longer be treated with light, floating lung medicines. One must examine the constitution and the details of the pattern. The ancients said, "In treating disease one should be lively and fluid, like a pearl rolling on a plate."
Shen Yaofeng said, "In heaven it is dryness, on earth it is metal; dryness is also one of the five qi."
But nothing dries all things more than fire.
